Which used truck fits my work?

Match the truck to the job: light duty for daily driving and lighter loads, heavy duty for regular towing. Check the undercarriage and service history on any used truck.

Silverado vs F-150 vs Ram vs Toyota trucks

Each has tradeoffs. Ask for the exact rating by VIN, not the badge.

Chevrolet Silverado 1500

Strong towing range and multiple engine choices.

Ford F-150

Very common in Iowa and widely supported for used parts.

Ram 1500

Coilspring rear ride quality on gravel roads.

Toyota Tundra and Tacoma

Long-term Toyota durability and local Toyota service.

Towing: what the numbers actually mean

Towing capacity is what the truck pulls. Payload is what the truck carries. Check the door-jamb payload sticker and OEM towing chart.
